marks.claim: Costco operates membership warehouses and e-commerce sites based on the concept of offering low prices on a limited selection of nationally-branded and private-label products to achieve high sales volumes and rapid inventory turnover [10-K line 00134]. The company buys most merchandise directly from suppliers, routes it through cross-docking consolidation points or directly to warehouses, creating freight volume and handling efficiencies that lower costs compared to traditional distribution channels [10-K line 00135]. Costco's warehouse format features a no-frills, self-service layout with strict inventory controls, including membership requirements, to reduce shrinkage and labor costs [10-K line 00139]. The company operates in multiple countries and offers a range of categories including foods and sundries, non-foods, fresh foods, warehouse ancillary (such as gasoline), and other businesses like e-commerce and travel [10-K line 00143]. Membership fees are $65 annually in the U.S., with Executive memberships offering additional rewards redeemable at warehouses [10-K line 00157].

marks.source: 00134: We operate membership warehouses and e-commerce sites based on the concept that offering low prices on a limited selection of nationally-branded and private-label products in a wide range of categories will produce high sales volumes and rapid inventory turnover. When combined with the operating efficiencies achieved by volume purchasing, efficient distribution and reduced handling of merchandise in no-frills, self-service warehouse facilities, these volumes and turnover enable us to operate profitably at significantly lower gross margins (net sales less merchandise costs) than most other retailers. We often sell inventory before we are required to pay for it, even while taking advantage of early payment discounts.; 00135: We buy most of our merchandise directly from suppliers and route it to cross-docking consolidation points (depots) or directly to our warehouses. Our depots receive large shipments from suppliers and quickly; 00139: Our average warehouse space is approximately 148,000 square feet, with newer units being slightly larger. Floor plans are designed for efficiency in the use of selling space, the handling of merchandise, and the control of inventory. Because shoppers are attracted principally by the quality of merchandise and low prices, our warehouses are not elaborate. By strictly controlling the entrances and exits and using a membership format, we believe our inventory losses (shrinkage) are well below those of typical retail operations.; 00143: We offer merchandise and services in the following categories:; 00157: Our members may utilize their memberships at all of our warehouses and e-commerce sites. Our annual fee for memberships is $65 in the U.S., varies in other countries and includes a free household card.

marks.claim: Costco's growth story is supported by disclosed evidence of customer demand and reported results from new product or market expansion. The company opened 28 new warehouses in 2026, including three relocations, resulting in a net of 25 new warehouses [10-K line 00415]. Comparable sales increased 8% in 2026, driven by increases in average ticket and shopping frequency, indicating strong customer demand [10-K line 00451]. Digitally-enabled comparable sales grew 21%, demonstrating progress in online offerings [10-K line 00452]. Membership fee revenue increased 11% to $5.9 billion, supported by new member sign-ups and upgrades to Executive memberships, reflecting sustained demand for membership [10-K line 00458].
